content.name: Daniel Kwan
content.title: Senior Sales Associate
content.summary: Senior sales associate with nine years in specialty running, kitchenware and outdoor retail in Vancouver. Known for technical product knowledge and patient selling; currently the top performer for high-value outerwear and tents, with $640,000 in personal sales last year.

experience.title: Senior Sales Associate
bullets: Sold $640,000 in 2025, leading the store in technical outerwear, tents and avalanche safety equipment.
Lead in-store clinics on layering and backcountry gear every month, with 30 to 50 attendees and a sales spike the following weekend.
Trained eight seasonal hires on product specs, the POS system and returns policy before the November rush.
Handled warranty claims with three suppliers, cutting average turnaround from five weeks to two and a half.
Serve customers in English and Cantonese, which brought in a steady group of repeat families from Richmond and Burnaby.

experience.title: Sales Associate
bullets: Advised home cooks and restaurant staff on knives, cookware and small appliances, averaging $1,900 in daily sales.
Ran knife-sharpening Saturdays that sharpened 120 blades a month and introduced new customers to premium lines.
Set up curbside pickup and phone orders in spring 2020, keeping roughly 70% of usual revenue during closures.

experience.title: Sales Associate
bullets: Fitted runners after watching their stride on the in-store treadmill, recommending shoes, socks and insoles.
Recruited 90 members for a free weekly run club that became the store's main source of new customers.
Counted cycle inventory twice weekly and kept shrink below 1% of sales.

courses.name: Standard First Aid with CPR C

achievements.title: Top seller, outerwear and camping
achievements.detail: Highest category sales in the store for two winter seasons in a row.

achievements.title: Warranty fix
achievements.detail: Supplier claim turnaround halved after rewriting the claims checklist.
